name: Notion AI
freeTierNote: $0 plan includes a limited Notion AI trial (5 MB uploads); full Notion AI requires Business tier.
priceBand: Limited AI trial on Free/Plus; full Notion AI on Business — check official pricing
bestFor: Teams whose wiki, tasks, and specs already live in Notion
skipIf: You do not use Notion. Buying it for the AI alone is backwards.
keyFeatures: Queries your existing Notion wikis and databases
limitations: Not worth adopting Notion solely for the AI
summary: AI that is only as good as the workspace it sits on. A weak reason to migrate a company. A strong reason to stay.
body: Notion AI writes inside the pages you already have. That context is the product. Compared with Grammarly it is a worse proofreader and a better wiki summarizer. Compared with ChatGPT it is worse at general chat and better at “summarize this spec database.” Pricing is bundled in ways that change; we read the public AI product page on 18 Sep 2026. If a comparison site ranks it as a ChatGPT killer, close the tab.
notes: Clean the workspace before you blame the model
Permissions still apply. AI is not a backdoor.
Jasper is for marketing teams who do not live in Notion
